issues.desc: background.md Key Insights (line 5) and Solution Tradeoffs (line 8) use "CAS receipt(s)" without expanding CAS. The abbreviation is ambiguous (Compare-And-Swap vs Content-Addressed Storage). CHK-001 later says "content-addressed execution key" but background.md never defines CAS on first appearance.

background.md Key Insights (line 5) says U-03 is "ranked after U-01 and U-02" with no first-appearance expansion of U-01 or U-02. Solution Tradeoffs (line 8) later maps U-01/U-09 to "review epochs and later scoped re-review" but U-02 is never defined anywhere in background.md.

background.md Key Insights (line 5) uses "precise CertificationWindow invalidation" and CHK-003 context repeats CertificationWindow without defining it. A newly-onboarded reader of CLAUDE.md + background.md cannot tell whether CertificationWindow is an existing PRE_CERT command family or a new U-03 construct.

Checklist userSees are metric-field names and replay/log assertions (commandExecutions, uniqueExecutionKeys, receiptReuse, affectedNodeRerun, falseFresh), not quoted operator-facing terminal text. At wrap-up the operator still would not know which command they type (proof-or-stop validate / verification_run / evidence import) or which last line means the work is done. PLAN understanding.outcome must be a concrete transcript, not another metric list.

CHK-002 userSees stops at a halfway telemetry state: after a simulated Git/metadata commit failure, logs show receiptReuse or importRetry with commandRerun=0 and the original receipt hash unchanged. That does not close the B-74af user loop. The operator done-moment is that the original PASS still becomes canonical evidence and they can continue without re-waiting the 93-command suite. Rewrite userSees to include successful canonical landing, not only retry/reuse logs.

CHK-003 userSees only shows efficiency numbers (specialized-command rerun=0, affectedNodeRerun=100%, falseFresh=0) and omits the proof-preserving half promised in Conversational Texture: after an unrelated merge the operator can still advance, and DONE-required whole-tree drift remains strict so an old pass does not enter a gate after a real related change. Add that closeout text so without-weakening-proof is user-visible, not only context.
